regionTag.label: Region
regionTag.hint: Override the Scene's region tag for this tile's encounter tables.

category.label: Habitat
category.hint: Which habitat table wild Pokémon are drawn from.

chance.label: Event Chance (%)
chance.hint: Chance that any event is rolled on each qualifying step.

onEveryStep.label: Trigger On Every Step
onEveryStep.hint: Roll while moving through the region, not only on entry.

outcomes.label: Outcome Weights
outcomes.hint: Relative odds of a wild Pokémon, item, trainer, event, or nothing.

minLevel.label: Minimum Level
minLevel.hint: Lowest level a wild Pokémon can be (unless a table row overrides it).

maxLevel.label: Maximum Level
maxLevel.hint: Highest level a wild Pokémon can be (unless a table row overrides it).

poolSource.label: Candidate Pool
poolSource.hint: By requirements (auto) computes eligible species from region + habitat + method; or use a region table or a custom table.

announceOnly.label: Announce Only
announceOnly.hint: Post a chat card instead of also spawning a wild token.

eventMacro.label: Event Macro
eventMacro.hint: Macro to run on a 'Special Event' outcome.

kind.label: Zone Type
kind.hint: Street, town, Pokémon Center, Poké Mart, or building interior.

healOnEnter.label: Heal On Enter
healOnEnter.hint: Pokémon Center: restore the entering trainer's party to full HP.

announce.label: Announce Entry
announce.hint: Post a chat message when a trainer enters.

move.label: Required Field Move
move.hint: A party Pokémon must know this HM/field move to pass (Surf, Cut, Strength…).

announce.label: Announce Use
announce.hint: Post a message when a Pokémon uses the field move to pass.

faction.label: Faction
faction.hint: Which group ambushes the player (Team Rocket, wandering trainers…). Members of that faction are not ambushed.

chance.label: Ambush Chance (%)
chance.hint: Chance to trigger on a qualifying step.

onEveryStep.label: Trigger On Every Step
onEveryStep.hint: Roll while moving through, not only on entry.

npcUuid.label: Specific NPC
npcUuid.hint: An exact NPC trainer to fight. Overrides the folder.

folder.label: NPC Folder
folder.hint: Name of an Actor folder of NPC trainers to draw a random opponent from.

mode.label: Resolution
mode.hint: Auto-resolve the battle, or just announce it for the GM to run.

moneyReward.label: Prize Money
moneyReward.hint: Awarded to the player on a win.

zoneName.label: Zone Name
zoneName.hint: Name announced when a trainer enters this region.

announce.label: Announce Entry
announce.hint: Post a chat message when a trainer enters.

destX.label: Entry X (px)
destX.hint: Where the token lands (destination scene, or same-scene warp).

destY.label: Entry Y (px)
destY.hint: Where the token lands (destination scene, or same-scene warp).

destinationSceneName.label: Destination Scene (by name)
destinationSceneName.hint: Name of the scene to travel to — survives compendium import. Preferred over the UUID.

destinationScene.label: Destination Scene (UUID)
destinationScene.hint: Fallback if no name is set.
